# AreaChart

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Area chart that renders a filled polygon with a line overlay. Now supports multiple series with transparency for overlapping areas. Uses the ICanvas interface for rendering, making it backend-agnostic.

Namespace `BonniePDF`. Extends `CartesianChartBase`.

## Constructors

```csharp
new AreaChart()
new AreaChart(ChartData data)
```

## Properties

- [`AreaColor`](#areacolor): Color for the area fill and line (backward compatibility for single-series charts).
- [`DefaultFillOpacity`](#defaultfillopacity): Default fill opacity for all series (can be overridden per series via Style).
- [`DefaultLineWidth`](#defaultlinewidth): Default line width for all series (can be overridden per series via Style).
- [`FillOpacity`](#fillopacity): Opacity for the area fill (backward compatibility for single-series charts).
- [`LineWidth`](#linewidth): Width of the line stroke (backward compatibility for single-series charts).
